title: Top derived module base change on cohomology presheaf classes
statement:
Let $f:X\to S$ and $g:T\to S$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with cartesian square $X_T=X\times_ST$, $v:X_T\to X$, $f_T:X_T\to T$ [def-pc-base-change]. Let $F$ be an $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], $q\geq0$, and assume $R^if_*F=0$ for $i>q$ [pqf-def-cohomology]. Put $C=Rf_*(F[0])$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image, def-pc-derived-category]. Let $\delta_g:Lg^*C\to Rf_{T,*}((v^*F)[0])$ be the canonical module base-change map [def-pc-derived-module-base-change-map], with derived and ordinary pullbacks [def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-module-pullback]. Use $\kappa_{g,C}:H^q(Lg^*C)\xrightarrow{\sim}g^*R^qf_*F$ of [lem-weil-pbc-derived-pullback-top-cohomology], and put $b_g^q=H^q(\delta_g)\kappa_{g,C}^{-1}$. Let
$$a_g^q:R^qf_*F\longrightarrow g_*R^qf_{T,*}(v^*F)$$
be the ordinary adjoint of $b_g^q$ [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. For an open $V\subseteq S$, put $U=f^{-1}V$, $W=g^{-1}V$, $U'=v^{-1}U=f_T^{-1}W$; the restricted map is $v_V:U'\to U$. Let $\theta_V$ and $\theta'_W$ denote the canonical cocycle-to-sheafification maps
$$H^q(U,F|_U)\to\Gamma(V,R^qf_*F),\qquad H^q(U',(v^*F)|_{U'})\to\Gamma(W,R^qf_{T,*}v^*F)$$
of [lem-weil-pbc-higher-direct-image-presheaf]. Then
$$\Gamma(V,a_g^q)\,\theta_V=\theta'_W\,v_V^*.$$
Here $v_V^*$ is the module cohomology map of the restricted ordinary pullback unit [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap], with its coefficient identified with $(v^*F)|_{U'}$ by [lem-pc-module-pullback-identity-composition]. No affineness, flatness, quasi-coherence, or invertibility of $\delta_g$ is assumed.
